integrity: The claim is derived from the primary source's displayed offspring matrix and reproduction-number identities; the finite witness is independently replayed with exact rational arithmetic.
scientific_limitations: The result compares only the household-based and individual-based reproduction numbers, not outbreak probabilities, final sizes, growth rates, basic reproduction numbers, or vaccination thresholds.
The square-root endpoint is approached as the direct-global contribution tends to zero; with positive global-contact rates it need not be attained.
Literature searches and full-text checks cannot prove universal absence from all older or poorly indexed household-epidemic work.
title: A sharp quadratic frontier for reproduction-number rank reversals in household epidemics
